scope: External microSD on the LG Fx0 (owner-inserted 8 GB SDHC card, wiping approved), RAM-booted installed r8 kernel with an Fx0 DTB adding only the SDHC2 slot (fx0-linux integration/fx0-sdcard)
dt: sdhc_2 enabled with vmmc L18 2.95 V, vqmmc L21 1.8-2.95 V, cd-gpios GPIO37 active-low with pull-up, bus-width 4 (vendor description)
detection: 'Got CD GPIO'; mmc1: new high speed SDHC card; mmcblk1 SMI 7.50 GiB; ios 50 MHz, sd high-speed, 4-bit, 3.30 V
filesystem: wipefs, GPT with one basic-data partition, mkfs.vfat FAT32 label FX0TEST, mounted with uid/gid of the user
data: 64 MiB random file written and read back after dropping caches: SHA-256 match; about 4 MB/s write including sync, 20 MB/s read; the normal user can write
removal: unmounted cleanly; owner pulled and reinserted the card: kernel logged 'mmc1: card 59b4 removed' then redetected it 20 s later; filesystem and file hash intact after reinsertion
installed_system: unchanged (RAM boot); returned to r8 with taint 0; soak restarted 07:36
open: ship the slot in a kernel package and test boot with and without a card
UHS/1.8 V signalling (this card ran at 3.3 V high-speed)
